remarks: Charming 3-bedroom, 2-bath colonial in desirable neighborhood. The bright and airy open floor plan downstairs is perfect for relaxing and entertaining. Gleaming wood floors throughout. The stylish bathrooms feature heated floors. Every bedroom has custom California closet and the master suite includes a spacious walk-in closet. Enjoy your morning coffee on the large deck, overlooking a private, fenced yard with fire pit and built-in swing set. Conveniently located next to Stew Leonard's, shopping and I-95 FOR quick commuting.
